currency.basis: Live official birbank.az site currently serves the red wordmark as its logo; the catalog's pinwheel/rhombus is the legacy pre-rebrand Kapital Bank symbol, no longer the served brand mark.

identity.basis: birbank.az is the official site of Kapital Bank's retail brand (homepage title carries both names; kapitalbank.az apex redirects to it); the candidate mark is that bank's current brand logo.

assessment.independenceRationale: Both observations come from the bank's own properties (birbank.az and the kapitalbank.az apex redirect); direct official confirmation, not mirror-based.

variant.basis: The candidate is the complete current logo (wordmark plus leading glyph); the letters form the mark itself, so the no-separate-lettering rule does not disqualify it. No standalone non-text Birbank symbol was found served officially.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Wordmark glyph outlines and the leading parallelogram preserved exactly; source/final pairs on both themes show no lost or invented details.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Wordmark aspect preserved by uniform scale; placed with even vertical clearances in the 54x54 cell; at catalog icon size the lettering remains readable on both themes (verified in the exact 240x240 desktop frames).
candidate.rationale: Evidenced rebrand of the operating retail brand: Kapital Bank's catalog pinwheel/rhombus is superseded by the current Birbank wordmark served on the bank's own site (birbank.az, title 'Birbank - Ilk reqemsal bank | Kapital Bank'; kapitalbank.az apex redirects there). Update replaces the obsolete design with the current official brand mark.
candidate.role: Complete current brand mark: the red 'birbank' wordmark with its leading parallelogram glyph; the letters form the mark itself, so the no-separate-lettering rule does not disqualify it. No backing field, transparent mark.
transforms: Carried the official wordmark SVG paths verbatim (class st0 mapped to explicit fill #FF0039, same color value); no geometry change.
Uniform scale 0.07591 and translation to fit the 685x248.2 lockup into a 54x54 canvas (catalog convention), horizontally near-full-width and vertically centered; no other change.

proposals.reason: Current catalog icon is the legacy Kapital Bank red pinwheel/rhombus. The bank's retail identity has been rebranded to Birbank: the official birbank.az homepage titles itself 'Birbank - Ilk reqemsal bank | Kapital Bank' and serves the red #FF0039 'birbank' wordmark (with its leading parallelogram glyph) as the current logo, in two byte-identical official SVGs. The catalog mark is the superseded pre-rebrand design; candidate is the current official brand mark (the wordmark itself is the whole mark, so letters forming the mark are allowed).

sources.observation: Official birbank.az homepage (title 'Birbank - Ilk reqemsal bank | Kapital Bank') serves the red 'birbank' wordmark logo. Two byte-identical SVG copies served at /file/new_logo_5fe2b40e30.svg and /file/new_logo_e657504d12.svg (Adobe Illustrator 28.3.0 export, viewBox 0 0 685 248.2, single class .st0 fill #FF0039, 2284 bytes).
